entries.gated_by: nothing calls it; CLAUDE.md documents the underlying `uvx ruff format python/` command directly instead of this wrapper

entries.title: cargo fmt wrapper
entries.subject: Thin wrapper: exec cargo fmt --all "$@".
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it directly, though feature-build-gate.yml runs the equivalent `cargo fmt --all -- --check` inline

entries.title: Combined format+lint+typecheck
entries.subject: Runs cargo fmt, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -D warnings, ruff format, ruff check --fix, ty check in sequence.
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it -- confirmed explicitly in scripts/feature-build-gate.sh's own header comment ('neither is called from anywhere')
entries.notes: --all-features used to die in build.rs on any machine without Bitwuzla, before clippy saw a line; this is the documented reason feature-build-gate.sh exists as a separate, working gate.

entries.title: ruff check wrapper
entries.subject: Thin wrapper: exec uvx ruff check python/ --fix "$@".
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it; CLAUDE.md documents the underlying command directly

entries.title: cargo fmt --check + clippy -D warnings
entries.subject: Runs cargo fmt --all -- --check then cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, with GLAURUNG_BITWUZLA_TYPECHECK_ONLY=1 so the Bitwuzla-absent build.rs panic doesn't kill it before clippy runs.
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it (confirmed in feature-build-gate.sh's own comment); currently red with ~260 pre-existing clippy errors under -D warnings
entries.notes: CLAUDE.md calls this out explicitly: would catch a whole class of feature-build-gate failures but nothing runs it, and it only became runnable at all on 2026-08-17 once GLAURUNG_BITWUZLA_TYPECHECK_ONLY existed.

entries.title: ty check wrapper
entries.subject: Thin wrapper: exec uvx ty check python/glaurung "$@" (package only, ignoring tests).
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it; CLAUDE.md documents `uvx ty check python/` directly (a broader scope: package + tests)
entries.notes: Scope mismatch vs. the CLAUDE.md-documented command: this wrapper only checks python/glaurung, not all of python/.

entries.title: Adversarial embedded-content corpus builder
entries.subject: Deterministically builds samples/adversarial/embedded/ (nested archives, base64-in-ELF, gzip-wrapped, etc.) from existing hello-* binaries plus synthetic constructions.
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it; its output (14 tracked files under samples/adversarial/) is read by python/tests/test_adversarial_coverage.py
entries.notes: Same shape as build-macho-samples.sh: one-shot committed-fixture generator, no automated caller.

entries.title: Head-to-head DecBench metrics
entries.subject: Compares DecBench metrics head-to-head across decompilers (glaurung/ghidra/angr), per lane and per program.
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it; only referenced from a July 2026 diary -- appears superseded by tools/decbench_compare_full.py
entries.notes: Orphan: no script/tool/test currently invokes it, unlike decbench_compare_full.py which has a live test.

entries.title: Per-cell DecBench metric ratchet
entries.subject: Runs the real decbench evaluate pipeline for 14 programs x {gcc,clang} x {O0,O2} = 56 cells and compares each against a committed baseline (GED / type-match / byte-match).
entries.gated_by: opt-in: scripts/decbench-local-gate.sh lanes 4-5 (--decbench flag / GLAURUNG_RUN_DECBENCH=1 only); never in CI
entries.notes: The ONLY lane that scores GED/type_match/byte_match; a missing DECBENCH_DIR used to skip silently and now hard-fails (test_local_gate_fails_closed.py guards this).

entries.title: Regenerate defuse_baseline.json
entries.subject: Regenerates tests/decompiler_fixtures/defuse_baseline.json, the committed per-function def-before-use census the ratchet compares against.
entries.gated_by: manual only, run after independently confirming a change is real (CLAUDE.md); never to make a red gate green
entries.notes: CLAUDE.md: an arity fix once shipped with this baseline unrefreshed because the census lane isn't in any fast gate list.

entries.title: glaurung.dev fixture gallery JSON
entries.subject: Runs every fixture across all toolchain/optimization lanes and emits the JSON that renders the public glaurung.dev fixture gallery, including the pass/fail execution-differential verdict per function.
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it; manual publishing tool writing outside this repo (a sibling glaurung.dev checkout)
entries.notes: Most recently modified file in tools/ (Aug 31, same day as this survey). No caller anywhere in-repo -- entirely a human-run publishing step.
